Bumps [fastmcp](https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp) from 3.2.0 to 3.4.10.
Release notes

Sourced from fastmcp's releases.

v3.4.10: Back in Check

This release backports component authorization checks after transforms and prevents denied concrete resources from being served by matching templates. All 3.x users are encouraged to upgrade. Thanks to our 2 contributors, including 1 first-time contributor.

What's Changed

Security 🔒

  • Backport authorization of transformed components and prevent denied-resource template fallback by @​zzstoatzz and @​rishid in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5934

New Contributors

  • @​rishid made their first contribution in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5934

Full Changelog: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/compare/v3.4.9...v3.4.10

v3.4.9: Contain Yourself

This release backports security fixes from 4.1: OpenAPI path parameters reject . and .. segments, a skill's SKILL.md must stay inside its skill folder, regex tool search is bounded in time and pattern length, and JWT verifiers share JWKS refreshes instead of fetching on every unknown key ID. All 3.x users are encouraged to upgrade. Thanks to our 6 contributors, including 3 first-time contributors.

What's Changed

Security 🔒

  • [3.x] Backport OpenAPI dot-segment and skill containment fixes by @​zzstoatzz, @​GEONWOOHAN, and @​avrlab233 in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5765
  • [3.x] Bound regex tool search with Pydantic's regex engine and a time budget by @​zzstoatzz and @​SAYUTIM in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5768

Fixes 🐞

  • [3.x] Share JWKS refreshes across key lookups by @​zzstoatzz and @​YuvalElbar6 in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5769

Docs 📚

  • docs: credit contributors in v3.4.8 changelog entries by @​jlowin in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5450
  • docs: add v3.4.9 changelog entries by @​zzstoatzz in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5772

New Contributors

  • @​avrlab233 made their first contribution in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5765
  • @​SAYUTIM made their first contribution in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5768
  • @​YuvalElbar6 made their first contribution in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5769

Full Changelog: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/compare/v3.4.8...v3.4.9

v3.4.8: Long Arm of the Patch

This release contains important security and bug fixes. All users are encouraged to upgrade. Thanks to our 2 contributors.

What's Changed

Security 🔒

  • [3.x] Apply Host/Origin protection settings to the SSE transport by @​jlowin in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5428
  • [3.x] Exclude Cookie from forwarded HTTP headers by @​jlowin in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5429
  • [3.x] Pass client CLI arguments literally to Windows .cmd wrappers by @​jlowin and @​strawgate in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5420
  • [3.x] Use the server's auth provider for component manager routes by @​jlowin and @​strawgate in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5426
  • [3.x] Bound CIMD cache growth by @​jlowin in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5430
  • [3.x] Include resource metadata in component manager auth challenges by @​jlowin in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5435
  • [3.x] Apply transforms, enabled state, and auth to hashed tool lookups by @​jlowin and @​strawgate in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5416
  • [3.x] Build client schema types with create_model and bounded caches by @​jlowin and @​strawgate in PrefectHQ/fastmcp#5414

... (truncated)
